CreateAuthenticatorRegistration.description_en: Initializes the creation of an authenticator

FetchAccessToken.description_en: Retrieves an application API authorization access token for subsequent authenticator-related API calls
FetchAccessToken.description_zh: 获取一个应用API授权访问的token, 用于后续认证器相关接口调用

GetAuthenticator.description_en: Retrieves the details of an authenticator

ListCostUnitOrders.description_en: Performs a paged query of orders and their compute unit (CU) usage information, sorted by creation time in descending order with paging support
ListCostUnitOrders.description_zh: 分页查询订单及其 CU 用量信息，按创建时间倒序排列

ListOrderConsumeStatisticRecords.description_en: Queries daily usage statistics records for an order by paging. Results are sorted by statistics date in ascending order. The maximum date range is 31 days. If the range exceeds 31 days, the system counts 31 days backward from the maximum date. Statistics records are generated on a T+1 basis, and the previous day's usage is calculated before 12:00 of the current day
ListOrderConsumeStatisticRecords.description_zh: 分页查询订单每日用量统计记录，按统计日期正序排列。统计日期最大区间范围为 31 天，如果超过从最大值向前推 31 天。T+1 出统计记录，当天12点前统计出昨天的用量

ServiceInvoke.description_en: Determines the authentication method based on ServiceCode and Action
ServiceInvoke.description_zh: 根据 ServiceCode 和 Action 决定是使用哪种认证方式认证

UpdateAuthenticatorAttribute.description_en: Updates the name of an authenticator

VerifyIdToken.description_en: Verifies an IdToken. After phone number verification or IFAA authentication succeeds, the obtained IdToken must be verified by calling this operation
VerifyIdToken.description_zh: 用于验证 IdToken。号码认证或者 IFAA 认证通过后，获得的 IdToken 需要通过此接口验证
